title: Normality part of localized relative normalization
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme whose local rings are integrally closed [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $c:C\to S$ be quasi-compact, quasi-separated and smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $U\subset S$ be open, $P\to C_U=c^{-1}(U)$ a finite etale scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $s\in S$. Put $f:P\to C_U\to C$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$ with projection $l:L\to C$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $n:N=f.\mathrm{normalization}\times_C L\to L$, where relative normalization means integral closure of $\mathcal O_C$ in $f_*\mathcal O_P$ [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization].. Then every local ring of N is a domain and integrally closed.

proof.text: Normality of S follows from its domain stalks and hS. Smooth ascent gives normality of C, and etale ascent normality of P. Finite presentation gives locally Noetherian sources and therefore finitely many irreducible components in every quasi-compact source open.

Apply Stacks 035L to the affine integral-closure charts of relative normalization: each source chart splits into finitely many normal integral components with normal domain section rings; the integral closures are normal domains, and the normalization chart is their disjoint union.

Over an affine neighbourhood Spec R of s, the pullback to Spec R_p localizes the integral-closure chart rings at R minus p. Nonzero such localizations are normal domains; zero rings have empty spectrum. Further localization at each point gives the desired stalk properties. This is localization of the explicitly constructed chart rings, not an assertion that normality survives arbitrary flat base change.

theorem stalk_normalization_normal_part {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c]
    (U : S.Opens)
    (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (s : S) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let f := PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
    let l := pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s)
    let n := pullback.snd f.fromNormalization l
    ∀ z : (pullback f.fromNormalization l : Scheme.{u}),
      IsDomain ((pullback f.fromNormalization l : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk z) ∧
      IsIntegrallyClosed ((pullback f.fromNormalization l : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk z)
